home.heroDesc: A successful Proof-of-Concept dedicated to making the internet safer, respect user's privacy, and provide zero-proof knowledge identity verification.
home.overviewBody1: Current online identity verification methods require internauts to share sensitive information or documents to online service providers in order to gain access to a platform or service. While effective, there is a violation of privacy and risk of exposure if not protected correctly, and due to growing incidents of centralized data breaches, users show discomfort and lack of trust towards these procedures. This project aims to design and apply an alternative, decentralized method for online identity verification, prioritizing user’s privacy..
home.overviewBody2: Encrypted shards are distributed across nodes to improve resilience and reduce single points of failure.
guarantees: Third parties/companies will never see your personal information.
Your protected data will be owned by no one, decentralized storage and key sharding will keep it safe.
The system is highly scalable, efficient, and user-friendly.
Data redundancy will keep the service available.
home.authorityBody1: Is in charge of the network of nodes and the web portal, responsible for their maintenance. This entity also is responsible for verifying the information users submit to the network, only once each time it is updated. This is to make sure all the information saved in the databases is legally correct.
home.authorityBody2: The signed result can be reused without exposing raw personal data.
home.storageBody1: Once the data is encrypted with a random key, the latter gets fragmented using Shamir’s Secret Sharing. The key is divided into a certain number of shares, then each one of them is distributed randomly across the network. This way, not a single node can access the information, and the encrypted data may only be accessed when the user requests the nodes to put the fragments back together again.
home.storageBody2: Threshold reconstruction and integrity checks help maintain privacy and reliability.
home.requestCardBody: A verifier requests proof of a specific attribute without asking for the full identity.
home.executionCardBody: Nodes work collaboratively in an automated process to verify the passed criteria.
home.responseCardBody: The verifier receives a boolean answer resulting from the verification process, with no additional data.
home.trustBody1: In this project, we successfully designed and implemented a proof-of-concept decentralized storage network for online identity verification. The system demonstrates that it is possible to verify user identity attributes without exposing sensitive personal information, addressing a critical issue in modern digital services. By combining encryption, key fragmentation, and a peer-to-peer network, the solution reduces reliance on centralized databases and minimizes the risk of large-scale data breaches.
home.trustBody2: Decentralized nodes enforce policies, reduce single points of failure, and improve transparency.

about.title: About DIDN
about.body: DIDN is a course project that explores privacy-preserving verification using decentralized storage and threshold cryptography. Our goal is to let user data be verified once by a trusted authority, then encrypted and distributed across independent nodes—so future checks can return policy-compliant proofs without exposing raw personal data.
bullets: Reduce repeated identity verification and unnecessary data exposure
Minimize trust after the initial verification step
